name: Mamotte Kurechau
original_name: まもってくれちゃうっ
source:
Yui is a second year student at a private boy's school. One day he finds an anonymous love letter in his shoe box. He heads to the place of meeting and meets another boy in strange circumstances!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Yui是私立男校二年级学生。一天，他在鞋柜中发现一封匿名情书。前往约定地点后，他在奇怪的情形下遇见了另一名少年！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
